# Isolated beta.4 visual fixture

Generated by tools/generate_crops4_fixture.py. Requires only Greenhouse and
NeoForge in a separate test world, never a user save.

Three rows show sea pickles, moss and chorus in four stages. Comparison rows
use artificial NBT duration 600000 ticks so intermediate stages stay visible.
They do not verify timing: exact 600/900-tick durations are checked by the live
server tests. Separate manual harvest machines at x=12 and automatic machines
at x=16 use real production durations. The latter export to chests.

Hotbar 1: overview. 2/3/4: stage rows. 5/6/7: real manual harvests.
8: automatic chorus. 9: automatic sea-pickle chest. Blue orchid, kelp and
an empty greenhouse at x=21 provide previous-model comparisons.

The observed native-client run uses G for Use, configured only in the isolated
profile to avoid moving a captured game cursor when opening a machine.

Drop the selected camera item before a free teleport. For the moss/chorus
chests use `/tp @s 16.5 120 6.5 180 40` or
`/tp @s 16.5 120 10.5 180 40`. Slot 9 targets the sea-pickle chest directly.
